whyThisMatters:
Play design tool for (American) football offenses that auto-generates quizzes so players learn the playbook before game day. Aimed at football coaches and teams. Founded Jun 2025, UK. 260 active subscriptions.

Vertical tool for a stubborn, spreadsheet-and-whiteboard audience (high-school coaches) with a seasonal buying moment. The quiz angle is what competitors don't do. Revenue went from 500 dollars a month to 6.8k dollars a month in about six months as the season started.

A coach draws the play, and the tool turns it into a quiz the players take before the game. The buyers are coaches and teams. The company is in the UK, and the sport is American football. Cash jumps when the season starts and goes quiet in the winter. That is the shape of the year.

The same quiz idea works for a sport with a coach and a squad, sold once per team per season.
